bullets.text: Libby App Faces AI Backlash - **Libby** introduces AI book recommendations, sparking concerns among users about privacy and AI's role.
YouTube Boosts Smaller Creators - **YouTube** launches 'Hype' feature globally, helping creators with fewer than 500,000 subscribers gain visibility.
Verizon Revives Landline Feel - **Verizon** introduces Family Line, allowing up to five family members to share a single phone number.
SpaceX Achieves Starship Milestones - **SpaceX** successfully completes 10th Starship test, demonstrating new landing maneuvers and payload capabilities.
Assort Health Secures $50M - **Assort Health** raises $50 million to automate patient communications in specialty healthcare practices.
Microsoft Faces Protest Lockdown - **Microsoft** headquarters locked down after activists occupy president's office demanding policy changes.
Verily Shifts Focus to AI - **Verily** closes medical device program, reallocating resources to AI and data infrastructure.
Nuclear Fusion Gains Momentum - More companies are entering the **nuclear fusion** sector, aiming for clean energy breakthroughs.
Meta Launches Pro-AI Super PAC - **Meta** plans to invest millions in a super PAC supporting pro-AI candidates in California.
Google Translate Competes with Duolingo - **Google** introduces new language learning tools in Translate, challenging **Duolingo**'s dominance.
